html:
After a brief winter break, the Accudyne Team is back to it’s normal modus operandi: #InnovateEveryday. To help spread the word on our Innovative Custom Manufacturing Automation Solutions in the Composites Manufacturing Domain and our continuing Technical Partnership with Airborne, our team is preparing for the #JEC2024 Composites Industry Trade Show to be held March 5-7, 2024.

We are exhibiting in Hall5, Stand M71.

Text to copy code: EXH1218558410 

Our technical team will be onsite to #TalkNerdy with you about composites and manufacturing automation. Tony Johnson, Stephan Zweidler, and Mark Groseclose have decades of experience and will be onsite to meet with you!

Schedule a meeting with us! Once you have registered, you can open the link below, and search for “Accudyne”. Then click “Request a Meeting” and select a date and time!
